episode_title: Dixon Discovers Why the Window Turns Cloudy
episode_seed: Dixon discovers why his warm breath makes a cool window turn cloudy.
audience_fact: Warm, moist air forms tiny water droplets when it cools against cold glass.
fact_label: Cool glass turns water vapor into tiny droplets.
optional_narration: Dixon's warm breath carries water vapor. When it touches the cool window, the vapor cools into tiny droplets that look like fog.
